about: Three friends, A, B and C, planning a weekend when A's father, who is eighty-one and walks with a stick, comes to stay. Invented. About three minutes. One interruption (B cuts A at turn 9), one question from A met with silence (turn 12), one question put to verso by name and met with silence (turn 19).

turns.text: so my dad is coming on friday | and i want the weekend to be good for him | he hasn't been down since the spring
how is he doing with the walking
better than last year actually | he does the park most mornings | but stairs are still hard and he won't use the lift
we could do the river path on saturday | it's flat all the way to the lock and there's the cafe at the end
saturday is hard for me | i have the kids till four
right
sunday then | or we go saturday without you and do something all together on sunday
i'd rather be there for the walk | he likes the kids and they like him | what if we went late saturday and the kids came
the thing is he gets tired by three | so late saturday would mean a short one | and the cafe shuts at
the cafe shuts at five i checked | we'd be fine if we left here by half two
ok | half two could work | i'll ask him tonight
does anyone know if the path is open past the lock | they were doing something to the bank
anyway | for sunday i was thinking lunch here | nothing fancy | he liked the fish thing last time
he did | though he said the sauce was too much | he's very polite about it but he said it twice
he says that about everything with cream in it | i'll do it plain
and i was going to ask | should we invite june | she and your dad got on so well at christmas
i don't know | he gets shy with people he doesn't know well | and june talks a lot | kindly but a lot
june is lovely though | and he'd have someone his own age to talk to instead of us going on about the kids
verso what do you reckon | invite june or keep it small
well | we could leave it open | see how he is on saturday and decide then
yes | let's do that | if the walk goes well he'll be up for company
fine by me | i'll tell june it's a maybe | she won't mind
one more thing | the spare room | the bed is quite low | can he get up from it
oh | i hadn't thought of that | he struggled with the sofa last time
i've got those bed risers from when mum stayed | i'll bring them over thursday
that would be brilliant | thank you | right so friday he arrives about six
do you want me to pick him up from the station | you'll be cooking
would you | he'd like that | he always asks after you
done | six at the station | i'll bring the kids so they're not bouncing off the walls at yours
so saturday half two the river path | sunday lunch here | june a maybe | risers thursday | anything else
no | i think that's it | thanks both | he's going to love this
